verdict.rationale: Salv publishes a documented public API at docs.salv.com/api. It has a downloadable OpenAPI/Postman definition, OAuth2 client-credentials auth and a separate sandbox environment. The API covers persons and transactions (bulk CSV upload plus addPerson/addTransaction), real-time monitoring checks, alerts and manual alerts, risk factors, custom lists and outbound webhooks, which is enough for programmatic, agent-style use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as documented, and full configuration coverage, since the docs say only "some of the configuration" is available through the API.
